info.syllabusName: Chuỗi cung ứng tích hợp (Integrated SCM Capstone)
info.description:
This capstone course provides an integrative exploration of global supply chain management, emphasizing analytical, strategic, and sustainability-driven decision making. Students will begin by examining global supply chain structures, flows, and risks, and progress to advanced applications in demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and global distribution design. The course further develops expertise in transportation management, cost analysis, and strategic sourcing, enabling students to apply quantitative methods for performance evaluation and risk mitigation.

Building on contemporary challenges, students will design sustainable and green supply chain strategies that align with ESG standards, global regulations, and corporate social responsibility. Special focus is given to emerging trends such as digital transformation, automation, and global disruptions, ensuring graduates are well-prepared to adapt to future challenges.

The course culminates in a comprehensive capstone project where students synthesize theoretical knowledge and practical insights into a strategic supply chain plan, integrating resilience, efficiency, sustainability, and technological adaptability.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Students will be able to analyze and interpret global supply chain structures, identify critical risk factors and disruptions, and recommend strategies for resilience in international contexts.
Students will be able to apply quantitative methods such as forecasting models, inventory control techniques, and KPI-based performance assessments to evaluate and enhance supply chain efficiency.
Students will be able to design and justify supply chain strategies that incorporate sustainability principles, green logistics practices, and compliance with global regulations and ESG standards.

Students will be able to integrate knowledge across SCM domains in a capstone project, adapt strategies to technological advancements and globalization trends, and defend solutions through professional presentations.
